_comment: Releases while 1.0 is not final: master is a pre-release branch, so a merge
releases 1.0.0-rc.N (PyPI 1.0.0rcN), whatever the commit types, until a
stable release exists. The stable line is the branch `stable`, which
semantic-release requires to exist (a release branch it can release from;
`release` is taken by the old release/v0.2.x branches).
1.0.0 final: move `stable` to the commit to ship and run the Release on
merge workflow on `stable` (workflow_dispatch). After that, either keep
this shape (master makes 1.1.0-rc.N, `stable` the finals) or make master
the release branch (drop its `prerelease` and `channel`). RELEASING.md.
noteKeywords is narrowed to the HYPHENATED spelling on purpose (as in
mero-js, kotlin-sdk and swift-sdk): the parser matches note keywords
case-insensitively at the start of a line, so the default
['BREAKING CHANGE'] turns any body line beginning 'breaking change'
into a major release. `type!:` and a `BREAKING-CHANGE:` footer still
